class.name: AgentTools
class.brief_description: Entry point and version of the agent tools module.
class.description: Helpers for AI agents and automation: project validation ([AgentValidator]), property provenance ([AgentInspector]) and gameplay tests ([AgentTest]). Command-line flags: [code]--validate-project[/code], [code]--explain-property[/code], [code]--find-overrides[/code], [code]--resource-users[/code] and [code]--agent-test[/code].
